scope: Shared native server administration and screen-saver authority
invariant: Ordinary application and broker connections cannot administer shared X server state; public font definitions remain accessible to applications.
required_evidence: New counterexamples fail against the pre-patch server while positive controls pass.
Patched global, selection, extension, resource, and identity suites pass in Debug on both hosts.
The same native suites pass under ASan/UBSan on both hosts, with the GLX limit recorded.
Actual font names and font information remain available.
Explicit UngrabServer and KillClient AllTemporary enforce authority before effects.
The -ac flag cannot bypass host access administration authority.
Isolated bypass mutations for the server callback, screen-saver callback, explicit ungrab guard, temporary-resource reap guard, and -ac authority ordering are detected.
Locked P00-P10 assertions remain unchanged and pass against the patched server.
Source inputs and tested binary hashes match both hosts.
limitations: This component does not complete M04 or authorize untrusted native sessions.
Device authority, focus/pointer queries, atom privacy, selection namespaces, and asynchronous metadata remain unqualified.
Broker provisioning and compositor authority integration remain required.
Focused native-server sanitizers do not replace full runtime or hardware qualification.
